_comment: Flightdeck v2 delivery state. Single source of truth for wave/task progress. Plan of record: docs/ROADMAP.md. Product: docs/PRODUCT.md. Design: docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md. Test policy: docs/TESTING.md. Move task status between todo/in_progress/done/blocked as work proceeds, keep each wave's status in sync, and point 'next' at the lowest-numbered todo task of the current wave. The v1 state and its 79 task files are archived under .ai/archive/.
definitionOfDone: code implements the task and nothing beyond it
go tests: table-driven, hermetic, happy path + 2 error cases per exported func + cancellation; >=80% statement coverage; race clean
shell tests: bats coverage for any script with branching logic, kubectl/helm stubbed
api/cli tests: contract test per endpoint incl. error envelope; golden files for CLI output
ui tests: vitest for components, playwright for journeys
docs updated in the same commit (reference docs, architecture, ADR if a decision was made)
state updated: task status + next pointer

W0.title: Ground clearing & foundations
W0.goal: A clean, correctly-structured repository with CI that enforces the new quality bar, before any feature work begins.
exitCriteria: go build ./... and go test -race ./... pass from the repo root
CI fails a PR that drops any package below 80% coverage
CI fails a PR with a lint, shellcheck, gosec or govulncheck finding
no reference to AKS/EKS/GKE/marketplace remains outside docs/archive/
bats, vitest and playwright each run in CI

W0-T03.title: Move Go module to repo root; restructure into internal/{cli,httpapi,service,...}

W0-T06.title: Test harness scaffolding: bats runner + kubectl/helm stubs, Vitest + MSW, Playwright

W0-T08.title: Rewrite CLAUDE.md, README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md for v2

W0.note: All W0 tasks implemented. R00 executed end-to-end on macOS 15 (Apple Silicon, Go 1.26, Node 26) on 2026-08-22: every step green, including the gate-bites checks (coverage, portability). Fixes made during the run, all in W0-owned harness code: (1) macOS bash 3.2 could not build a reliably SIGTERM-ignoring process for the toolchain cancellation test — replaced the bash fixture with a Go helper-process (exec_unix_test.go); (2) the doctor missing-tool test hardcoded the Linux install hint — made GOOS-aware (cli/doctor_test.go); (3) make lint-shell was red — 34 tracked scripts were not shfmt -i2 clean, loki/install.sh had a dead RETENTION var (SC2034), and five engine/*.sh had SC1090 that newer shellcheck no longer suppressed via the old directive placement (fixed with `# shellcheck source=/dev/null`); the lint-shell find() also scanned ui/node_modules (fixed to */node_modules/*); (4) Playwright webServer bound vite preview to localhost which is IPv6-only on macOS while the healthcheck used 127.0.0.1 — pinned --host 127.0.0.1 (ui/playwright.config.ts); (5) removed dead marketplace/credential references (auth/policy.go + test, httpapi/server.go stubs) so the ADR-0001 grep is clean. Maintainer sign-off is the only thing outstanding: the AI ran the automatable steps; a human tick of the results table completes the wave.

W1.title: Durable core: store, run engine, toolchain
W1.goal: Every operation Flightdeck performs is cancellable, time-bounded, serialised against conflicts, and durably recorded.
exitCriteria: a run cancelled mid-helm-install leaves no orphaned child processes
killing the server mid-run and restarting shows the run cancelled with its partial log intact
a conflicting lock key is rejected in <100ms naming the holder
log stream reconnect with ?after=<seq> returns zero gaps and zero duplicates
labctl doctor distinguishes missing binary, outdated binary and unreachable cluster with actionable messages

W1-T01.title: internal/store: SQLite open/migrate/close, embedded forward-only migrations, schema-version guard

W1-T02.title: Store repositories: runs, run_logs, run_steps, audit with transactional writes

W1-T03.title: internal/toolchain: bash/kubectl/helm/k3d/kind adapters, argv-only, containment-checked script resolution

W1-T04.title: Toolchain preflight (min versions, actionable errors) + labctl doctor

W1-T05.title: toolchain.Fake for hermetic tests across all layers

W1-T06.title: internal/run: submit/queue/worker pool, exclusive lock keys, 409-on-conflict

W1-T07.title: Cancellation: process groups, SIGTERM to grace to SIGKILL, graceful server shutdown

W1-T08.title: Timeouts per run kind; timed_out terminal state

W1-T09.title: Durable log capture with monotonic sequence + cursor replay API

W1-T10.title: Step marker parsing to structured step timeline

W1.note: All W1 tasks implemented. internal/store 84.3%, internal/toolchain 95.0%, internal/run 87.3% — all race-clean and hermetic. R01 executed on macOS on 2026-08-22: every step green, including the three blocking ones — no process survives cancellation (pgrep clean), an interrupted run recovers with its log intact and lock released, and no log line is lost across a disconnect or a slow reader. Process-group SIGTERM->grace->SIGKILL confirmed on macOS. R02 executed on macOS 2026-08-22: steps 1-5, 7, 8 all green with good message quality (missing names tool+reason+fix, outdated shows both versions, unparseable does not block, optional tools warn only, broken PATH does not crash). Only R02 step 6 (stop Docker/Colima and confirm doctor does not hang) is outstanding — it is disruptive to the host and needs the maintainer to run it. Maintainer sign-off (that step + the message-quality judgement) completes the wave.

coverageRatchet: .coverage-exceptions lets packages awaiting rewrite sit below the 80% bar at a recorded floor they can never regress past. The gate fails if a listed package drops, if it clears 80% and the entry was not removed, or if an entry is stale. Adding an entry requires naming the wave that deletes it.
